intro: San Marino has one of the most unusual governments in the world: two heads of state who serve for just six months.

chapters.title: Two Captains Regent
text: Every six months, on 1 April and 1 October, the 60-member parliament elects two Captains Regent to serve together as heads of state, a system dating back to the Middle Ages.

chapters.title: San Marino in Europe
text: It is not in the EU but uses the euro by agreement with the EU.

keyTerms.meaning: One of San Marino's two joint heads of state.
